author: mountain state times
title: U.S. District Court announces probation officer job opening in Charleston, West Virginia
text:
U.S District Court For The Southern District Of West Virginia - Official website The U.S. District Court announced on May 20 a job opening for the position of U.S. Probation Officer or Probation Officer Assistant in Charleston, West Virginia.
The announcement is open to all qualified applicants and offers full-time, regular employment. The starting salary for the U.S. Probation Officer ranges from $59,732 to $116,394 per year at classification levels CL 27–28, while the Probation Officer Assistant position offers a salary range of $51,419 to $90,631 per year at classification levels CL 25–26. The actual starting pay will depend on education, experience, and qualifications.
Applications are being accepted until the position is filled; however, those received by June 7 will receive first consideration. The posting notes that most salaries start near the beginning of their respective pay ranges and that there is promotion potential up to CL 28 without further competition.
Interested candidates are encouraged to review the complete job description provided by the court for more information about duties and requirements.
This job posting reflects ongoing efforts by federal courts to recruit qualified personnel for key positions supporting judicial operations.
